title: Advantages of Yandex Games | Yandex Games SDK

observations.statement: Yandex Games reports that 60% of its audience is in Russia and CIS and 40% in other countries.
observations.excerpt: Geography: Russia and CIS — 60% Other countries — 40%

observations.statement: Yandex Games reports its platform split as phones 50%, computers 40%, tablets and TVs 10%.
observations.excerpt: Platforms: Phones — 50% Computers — 40% Tablets and TVs — 10%

observations.statement: Yandex Games reports average player time on the platform of 55 minutes.
observations.excerpt: Average player time on the platform — 55 minutes.

observations.statement: Yandex Games reports that the 35–44 age group makes up 49% of its players.
Yandex states its publishing requirements are lower than Google Play and other platforms.
observations.excerpt: Publishing requirements on Yandex Games are lower than on Google Play and other platforms.
